root_cause.text: In macvlan_common_newlink(), when adding a new macvlan device to an existing macvlan port (create=false), a failure in register_netdevice() does not remove the source MAC address entry that was added to the port's hash, leaving a dangling pointer to the freed net_device and causing a use-after-free in packet forwarding.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the error handling in macvlan_common_newlink() to unconditionally call macvlan_flush_sources() when the lower device has a macvlan port, and only conditionally calls macvlan_port_destroy() when create is true. The original code only called macvlan_flush_sources() when create was true, thus missing the case where the port already existed. The CVE description and commit message confirm that the bug triggers when register_netdevice() fails after macvlan_change_sources() adds the new vlan's source entry to the existing port's hash.

The original code only called macvlan_flush_sources() when create was true, thus missing the case where the port already existed. intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing cleanup of source entries in macvlan error path by always calling macvlan_flush_sources when the port exists, regardless of the create flag.
intent_record.what: Moved the `macvlan_flush_sources` call outside the `create` condition, so it is always executed when the port exists, while `macvlan_port_destroy` remains guarded by the `create` flag.
intent_record.how: Previously, `macvlan_flush_sources` was only called when `create` was true. Now it runs even when `create` is false (e.g., in failure paths), ensuring source entries are cleaned up in all cases. The port destruction still only occurs if a new port was being created.

grouping_result.intent: Fix missing cleanup of source entries in macvlan error path by always calling macvlan_flush_sources when the port exists, regardless of the create flag.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the root cause by ensuring macvlan_flush_sources is called in the error path of macvlan_common_newlink when the port exists, preventing a dangling pointer and use-after-free after a failed register_netdevice.

candidates.rationale: This condition guards the cleanup of source entries via macvlan_flush_sources. When create is false (i.e., adding to an existing port), a failure in register_netdevice() leaves the source entry dangling, causing a use-after-free. The condition should not require create to be true.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition guards macvlan_flush_sources, but when create is false (adding to an existing port), a register_netdevice() failure leaves the source MAC entry dangling, causing a use-after-free. The condition requires create to be true, so the cleanup is skipped in the error path when create is false.
